name: 33rd Scientific Research and Testing Institute
supervisors: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation

evidence.summary: The US Commerce Department found reasonable cause to believe that the 33rd Scientific Research and Testing Institute is a Ministry of Defense facility associated with the Russian chemical program and chemical weapons testing range, and listed it in August 2020.
It belongs to Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation.

sources.title: Addition of Entities to the Entity List, and Revision of Entries on the Entity List (85 FR 52898, 27 August 2020)
sources.publisher: US Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (Federal Register)

history.change: Record created from the Named Research Organizations list; not yet verified.
